arithmetic.prediction_stay: every double resolves within 72 steps, so after 8000 steps at most 40 survive, with no sharing
arithmetic.prediction_sighted: a losing organism can leave before the clock runs out, so some surplus survives

fires.evidence: stay alive 40 doubles 0; sighted alive 42 doubles 2

silent.evidence: stay has 0 double-occupied cells and max 1 per cell; arithmetic says a permanent second occupant takes 0.5000000000000004 against cost 0.63 and dies in 72 steps, and the run is 8000 steps

specific.evidence: sighted has 2 double-occupied cells at the end. The claim is not merely that sighted differs from stay but that it keeps sharing alive; a sighted run with no sharing would fail this

verdict.reason: the surplus is movement: forbidding movement settles the population at 40 with no sharing, while sighted holds 42 with 2 cells shared. The 2 extra organisms exist only because a losing organism can leave before its 72-step clock runs out

limitations: One seed, one field kind (uniform), one income (1.20), 8000 steps. The rotation itself is not timed here: EXP-52 sampled every 1000 steps and saw thirteen different organisms in sixteen second-occupant positions, but a rotation faster than one sample cannot be resolved from that data. The claim is that the surplus requires movement, not that it is exactly 2 for all parameters. Nothing here says whether the surplus grows or shrinks with move_cost, read_budget or n.
